revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate for achievement_medal_travel_tier_001, later converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one premium collectible travel achievement medal for tier 1, WHITE rank, based on the Chinese title concept "穷人乍富" (suddenly rich after being poor). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Input image role: the attached rank-medal screenshot is a reference for progressive border complexity only; do not copy its shield shape, numbers, dark UI, text, or exact design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. Tier 1 has the simplest rank frame: a clean ordinary circular medal with a pearl-white and polished silver rim, subtle bevel, very minimal tiny notches, no side wings, no crown, no bottom flourish. Inside the circle is one compact funny center object: a glossy cream-white travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses, smug and newly rich, closed and centered. The suitcase is the dominant readable shape.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, refined and readable at small iOS size, playful but premium, crisp transparent-asset silhouette, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: base circular size consistent with a six-medal set; tier 1 outer decoration is the smallest and simplest; full medal visible, no cropping; centered symmetrical front view.
Lighting/mood: soft bright studio rim light, modest white glints, intentionally over-serious luxury on a silly suitcase.
Color palette: pearl white, silver white, cream enamel center, tiny pale teal accent only if needed, black sunglasses, small white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: glossy enamel, polished pearl metal, subtle beveled rim, lacquered toy surfaces, clean edges. No paper texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: one medal only; no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no map, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no coins, no gold bars, no money pile, no confetti, no shield badge, no black background, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
title: 穷人乍富
concept: 银白普通圆形边框，中心为戴墨镜的旅行箱
integration_note: TripPet 1.0.8 travel medal redesign: six-level white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold rank progression; source PNG copied byte-identically to app-facing @3x PNG.
